findings.text: The company's status is recorded as 'administration', and its one insolvency case shows administration started on 20 March 2024.
The accounts are overdue; they were last made up to 31 October 2022 and the next accounts were due by 30 September 2024.
The confirmation statement is overdue; it was last made up to 24 October 2023 and the next statement was due by 7 November 2024.
The company was incorporated on 25 October 2018 and has 2 current directors: PERSON 314 (appointed 2 July 2021) and PERSON 315 (appointed 25 October 2018).
One current person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1445, holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights and the right to appoint and remove directors.
One charge is registered, and it is satisfied; no charges are outstanding or part-satisfied.
Across the 2 current directors, 11 other companies were found (8 dissolved, 2 liquidation, 1 active), and PERSON 314 is linked to a company in liquidation count of 2 across the network.
A registered office address change was filed on 30 December 2025, and no officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 429 (91000430) has status 'administration', with administration starting on 20 March 2024, and its accounts and confirmation statement are overdue.
